title: Product Demand and Availability Notification Flow
interaction_flow: alt availableQty == 0: status = 'Product is Out of Stock!'
alt availableQty < pQty: AddtoCart partially adds availableQty to cart
AddtoCart → DemandBean: new DemandBean(userName, prodId, pQty - availableQty)
DemandServiceImpl → Database: SELECT * FROM user_demand WHERE username=? AND prodid=?
alt demand already exists: return true (skip insert)
else: DemandServiceImpl → Database: INSERT INTO user_demand(username, prodid, quantity)
AddtoCart → Customer: response message 'We Will Mail You when product is available'
--- FLOW 2: Availability Notification (admin updates product quantity) ---
ProductServiceImpl → Database: UPDATE product SET pquantity=? WHERE pid=?
alt k > 0 AND prevQuantity < updatedProduct.getProdQuantity(): quantity increased
DemandServiceImpl → Database: SELECT * FROM user_demand WHERE prodid=?
loop for each DemandBean demand in demandList
ProductServiceImpl → MailMessage: productAvailableNow(demand.getUserName(), userFName, prodName, prevProductId)
DemandServiceImpl → Database: DELETE FROM user_demand WHERE username=? AND prodid=?
--- FLOW 3: FansMessage (fan feedback email - separate concern) ---
FansMessage → Customer: forward to index.jsp + JS alert with status message
key_relationships: DemandServiceImpl uses DBUtil for DB connection management
ProductServiceImpl depends_on DemandServiceImpl (new instance per call)

important_notes: Two distinct notification paths exist: (1) FansMessage servlet sends customer feedback to admin email directly via MailMessage.sendMessage — unrelated to stock. (2) Demand/notification flow: AddtoCart registers demand when stock insufficient → stored in user_demand DB table; ProductServiceImpl.updateProductWithoutImage triggers availability emails to all waiting customers when admin increases quantity; after each email, demand record is removed. DemandServiceImpl instantiated with 'new' (no DI). JavaMailUtil reads SMTP credentials from application.properties ResourceBundle. All MailMessage methods are static utility calls.
database_tables: user_demand (username, prodid, quantity) — stores pending demands
